item.title: The New Go JSON API: Twice As Fast, or 1.5x Slower?
How Swiss Tables Work in Go’s Built-in Map
item.description: Go 1.24 replaced the built-in map’s bucket-based runtime with Swiss Tables. This article explains groups, control bytes, H1 and H2, probing, table growth, directories, deletion, load factor, and the experimental split-group layout. (2 sources: golangweekly, lobsters)

item.description: Announcing TinyGo 0.42 with recoverable panics, Go 1.27 support, UEFI targets, and much more! (2 sources: golangweekly, lobsters)

item.description: How Checkly rewrote a Node.js service handling 92M messages a day into Go using AI agents, and the test harness that made it safe to ship. (2 sources: golangweekly, nodeweekly)
